newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BOXING-DUTCHMAN TUUR RETIRES, SURRENDERS WBO TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-DUTCHMAN TUUR RETIRES, SURRENDERS WBO TITLE.

text.p: Dutchman Regilio Tuur, the current World Boxing Organisation (WBO) super featherweight champion, said on Friday he was retiring and would surrender his title, the Dutch ANP news agency reported.
"I was a man with a mission and that mission has been accomplished," Tuur was quoted as saying.
The 29-year-old from Rotterdam, who boxed from New York, captured the WBO title in September 1994 and succesfully defended it six times.
